scoring_justification: Cannot recompute full Ewald summation and spherical defect kernel in the verifier sandbox; compare agent's computed a1 coefficients against paper's theoretical predictions with generous relative tolerance to absorb legitimate numerical spread from reimplementation.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold a1 coefficients from paper's Table I theoretical column
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text; same values used by reference solve.sh
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the published theoretical coefficients from the continuum elastic theory; they are the authoritative hidden target.

outputs.description: Computed subleading coefficient a1 for the generalized Thomson problem on a sphere, using continuum defect theory, for both (n,0) and (n,n) icosadeltahedral lattices at five values of gamma.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare each submitted a1 value to the paper-reported theoretical prediction, using a relative tolerance large enough to absorb legitimate numerical differences from re-implementing the Ewald method and spherical kernel.
